lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Lower bend of the Z step, between the lower flange and the web, with outer skins 3 and 5 and a bend of about 89 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% put the apex marker on the outermost point of the outer-skin arc, 0.10-0.12 mm from the nearest point. Inner skin is about 3 mm along the bisector. The line runs parallel to the fold and covers its full width (points within 1 mm of the line span t -0.19 to 36.5 on a 36.3 mm line). The wider lower-flange tabs are outside the fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Upper bend of the Z step, between the web and the upper flange, with outer skins 6 and 4 and a bend of about 88 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% put the apex on the outer-skin arc apex, 0.04-0.07 mm from the nearest point. The line is parallel to the fold and spans its full width (t -0.5 to 36.3 on a 35.9 mm line).
